# How much will you really walk away with when you sell your home?

> Free home sale net proceeds calculator. See cash at closing after commissions, fees and payoff, estimate capital gains tax, find the list price that nets a target, and compare offers with concessions. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
